fit_reason: Whole pickup truck listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: Silver paint on the hood, fenders and doors looks reasonably clean but slightly flat rather than deeply glossy
Headlight lenses on both front corners look somewhat hazy and yellowed
Black plastic bumper lower valance and rear step bumper pads look a bit gray and faded
Light dust and road film on the lower rocker panels and rear bumper area
Interior not shown in any photo, so its condition can't be judged
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 2007 Colorado and it looks like a clean, well kept truck. The headlight lenses look a little hazy and the black bumper trim has faded some, both of which we can freshen up along with a wash and wax. We do pre-sale details that come to you. Would you like a quote?
